lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: {mc} reaches to lay the sword on her chest. The sword moves first.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It turns in her hand and slides across the stones, and its hilt comes to rest in {mc}'s palm.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It is warm. {Their} fingers close on it, and will not open again.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The steel runs like water in {their} grip and sets in a new shape. It is not her sword anymore.

lines.speaker: blade
lines.text: She ran so far. You will run farther.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: On the north road, more torches. A second horn answers the first.

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: They'll burn {village} looking for this. Better they follow me.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: {mc} leaves before dawn, with a dead woman's sword and no idea what it is.
